Independent reconstruction from the rectified icosahedral edge list gives 1,022 and 15,966 nonempty faces, respectively. In an independent replay with collapse_certificate.json as data, all 7,472 upper pairs were present, outside the target, codimension one, free with exactly one current immediate coface, and with maximal upper cells. The final face set equals the complete independently enumerated K_2. The contextual lower sequence of 426 pairs also replays to the exact prescribed fan surface, with f=(30,84,56), two triangles on each edge and connected cyclic links. The frozen verifier was inspected, not executed; the retained certificate and verification_output.txt identify the standalone replay. The original full stage and persistence claims are mathematically consistent but are not accepted as new. No equivariant or general collapse criterion is asserted.

value.rationale: The two adjacent nontrivial stages are canonically prescribed by a finite metric filtration. A reduction of the larger stage that is the identity on the entire smaller one is useful for relative or filtration-preserving simplicial computations, unlike separate reductions or a map known only up to homotopy. It supplies an exact reusable witness without subdivisions or expansions. The counts and the already-known barcode are not themselves credited as new value.
